item.name: 🔗 List Jobs
2a. List Jobs by Date and Time

request.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of import jobs for the authenticated institution, sorted by `insertDateTime`. `groupId` is omitted.

```
GET /v3/jobs?page=0&size=20&sort=insertDateTime,desc
```

Retrieve a paginated list of import jobs for the authenticated institution, sorted by experience group name.

Do not send `groupId` with this sort; `group.groupName` is supported only when `groupId` is omitted. Use `group.groupName,desc` to reverse the order.

```
GET /v3/jobs?page=0&size=20&sort=group.groupName,asc
```

item.description:
## 🔄 List Jobs Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2a | List Jobs by Date and Time | Retrieve a paginated list of import jobs for the authenticated institution, sorted by insert date and time. |
| 2b | List Jobs by Group Name | Retrieve a paginated list of import jobs for the authenticated institution, sorted by group name. |

request.description:
Retrieve active experience groups and identify the `experience_group_id` for subsequent requests.

Saves `experience_group_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v3/groups?page=0&size=50&sort=groupName,asc
```

Retrieve a paginated list of import jobs for a specific experience group.

Requires `experience_group_id` from Search for Experience Group ID (or set manually in the environment). Filters import jobs to a single experience group.

```
GET /v3/jobs?groupId={{experience_group_id}}&page=0&size=20&sort=insertDateTime,desc
```

item.name: 4a. Get Job Errors by Line Number

request.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of row-level errors for the specified import job, sorted by line number.

Requires `job_id` from List Jobs (or set manually in the environment). Use this request when the job completed with `PARTIAL_SUCCESS` or `FAILED`.

```
GET /v3/jobs/{{job_id}}/errors?page=0&size=20&sort=lineNbr,asc
```

item.name: 4b. Get Job Errors by Error Message

request.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of row-level errors for the specified import job, sorted by error message.

Requires `job_id` from Search for Job ID (or set manually in the environment). Use this request when the job completed with `PARTIAL_SUCCESS` or `FAILED`.

```
GET /v3/jobs/{{job_id}}/errors?page=0&size=20&sort=errorMsg,asc
```

item.description:

| 3 | Search for Job ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the import jobs, and select a jobId with a status of PARTIAL_SUCCESS or FAILED. |
| 4a | Get Job Errors by Line Number | Retrieve a paginated list of row-level errors for the specified import job, sorted by line number. |
| 4b | Get Job Errors by Error Message | Retrieve a paginated list of row-level errors for the specified import job, sorted by error message. |
